client_system_prompts.prompt_text: Kuwait Dinar (KWD) transactions use 3 decimal places. The fiscal year in Kuwait follows the standard Gregorian calendar unless specified.
For maintenance prompts about records that are "scheduled", "upcoming", "next week", or "this week", prioritize querying the "tabMaintenance" doctype over "tabMaintenance Visit".
When fetching sales or revenue aggregates from "tabSales Invoice", always filter by is_return = 0 unless the user specifically asks for return invoices.

IMPORTANT: In the 'tabSales Invoice' table, use the field 'custom_sales_person' (Link) when the user asks for a 'salesperson' or 'sales person'. Do NOT use 'sales_partner' and do NOT join 'tabSales Team' unless explicitly asked.

client_context_overrides.description: Standard business definition for net revenue across all modules.
use maintenance table instead of maintenance schedule
For Supernatural client, sales person is stored in the custom_sales_person field of the Sales Invoice table. Use this instead of joining with Sales Team.
